items.source: NOTE: Any ResultSets opened should be closed in finally blocks within the callback implementation. Spring will close the Statement object after the callback returned, but this does not necessarily imply that the ResultSet resources will be closed: the Statement objects might get pooled by the connection pool, with close calls only returning the object to the pool but not physically closing the resources.
items.translation: 注意： 在回调实现中的 finally 块内关闭任何打开的 ResultSet。Spring 会在回调返回后关闭 Statement 对象，但这并不一定意味着 ResultSet 资源会被关闭：Statement 对象可能会被连接池复用，close 调用仅将对象返回到池中，而不会物理关闭资源。

items.source:
Used internally by JdbcTemplate, but also useful for application code.
Note that the passed-in CallableStatement can have been created by the
framework or by a custom CallableStatementCreator. However, the latter is
hardly ever necessary, as most custom callback actions will perform updates
in which case a standard CallableStatement is fine. Custom actions will
always set parameter values themselves, so that CallableStatementCreator
capability is not needed either.
items.translation: 由 JdbcTemplate 内部使用，但也可用于应用程序代码。请注意，传入的 CallableStatement 可能由框架或自定义的 CallableStatementCreator 创建。然而，后者几乎从不必要，因为大多数自定义回调操作将执行更新，此时标准的 CallableStatement 即可满足需求。自定义操作始终会自行设置参数值，因此也不需要 CallableStatementCreator 的功能。

items.source:
If called without a thread-bound JDBC transaction (initiated by
DataSourceTransactionManager), the code will simply get executed on the
JDBC connection with its transactional semantics. If JdbcTemplate is
configured to use a JTA-aware DataSource, the JDBC connection and thus
the callback code will be transactional if a JTA transaction is active.
items.translation: 如果未在线程绑定的 JDBC 事务（由 `DataSourceTransactionManager` 发起）中调用，代码将直接在具有其事务语义的 JDBC 连接上执行。如果 `JdbcTemplate` 配置为使用支持 JTA 的 `DataSource`，则在存在活动的 JTA 事务时，JDBC 连接以及回调代码将是事务性的。

items.source:
Allows for returning a result object created within the callback, i.e.
a domain object or a collection of domain objects. A thrown RuntimeException
is treated as application exception: it gets propagated to the caller of
the template.
items.translation: 允许返回在回调中创建的结果对象，即领域对象或领域对象集合。抛出的 `RuntimeException` 被视为应用程序异常：它会被传播到模板的调用者。

items.source: SQLException - if thrown by a JDBC method, to be auto-converted into a DataAccessException by an SQLExceptionTranslator
items.translation: SQLException - 如果由 JDBC 方法抛出，将由 SQLExceptionTranslator 自动转换为 DataAccessException

items.source: Gets called by JdbcTemplate.execute with an active JDBC CallableStatement.
items.translation: 由带有活动 JDBC CallableStatement 的JdbcTemplate.execute调用。

items.source: DataAccessException - in case of custom exceptions
items.translation: DataAccessException - 针对自定义异常的情况

items.source: a result object, or null if none
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
